title: Oil Rubbed Bronze Shower Basket, 18.75-Inch Wall-Mounted Solid Brass Oval Combination Caddy, Matte Black, Allied Brass
description: This 18.75-inch shower basket in Matte Black adds a bold, timeless accent while keeping shampoo, soap, and essentials organized in the bathroom. Available in Oil Rubbed Bronze. Oil Rubbed Bronze offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper. The rich satin-like finish makes a dramatic statement that pairs well with traditional bathroom hardware. Built for wet environments, it uses solid brass construction with heavy-gauge, ventilated solid brass wires that are rust proof and drain quickly. The wall-mounted design saves shower space, and the concealed screw mounting system creates a clean, finished appearance. Use it as a shower basket (also called a shower caddy) to keep clutter off ledges and corners. Includes the basket and all installation hardware, with no assembly required. Designer finish provides corrosion-free performance. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty.
